## Collaborate or Connect

I welcome inquiries concerning research collaboration, methodological advising, grant development, evaluation, speaking, workshops, review panels, advisory service, and doctoral study.

The most productive collaborations typically begin early, when measurement, research design, and analysis can be considered together.

::: {.contact-layout}

::: {.contact-information}

### Areas of Engagement

- Research and grant collaboration
- Methodological advising
- Measurement and statistical analysis
- Program and project evaluation
- Advisory-board and scientific-committee service
- External methodological review
- Invited talks and keynote presentations
- Workshops and professional development
- Doctoral study and mentoring

### Direct Contact

For straightforward inquiries, you may contact me directly by email.

[Email Grant Morgan](mailto:grant_morgan@baylor.edu){.btn .btn-primary}

### Prospective Doctoral Students

Advising availability changes from year to year. Prospective students should briefly describe:

- academic background;
- methodological interests;
- quantitative preparation;
- reasons for considering Baylor;
- potential alignment with my work;
- long-term professional goals.

:::
